title: House of Leaves
author: Mark Z. Danielewski
summary: A tattoo-shop worker finds a dead man's manuscript about a documentary on a house that is larger inside than out. As he reads, the text, the footnotes and his own life start to unravel.
readIf: you want an experimental horror novel where the layout, footnotes and typography are part of the story.
skipIf: you want a straight narrative, because this is demanding and deliberately disorienting.

pairings.reason: Another story about an impossible building, though warm and beautiful rather than frightening.
The quiet classic of a house that works on the people inside it.
Another novel where exploring a place that follows its own rules changes those who enter.
